fusions.name: Notched Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows in a spread, each dealing 3 damage and leaving its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each arrow has a 30% chance to also leave its target [Exsanguination] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Harpoon Line
fusions.desc: Looses a barbed harpoon at an enemy up to 10 tiles away for 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. 25% of the damage it deals comes back to you along the line as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Far Scent
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Wounded Quarry
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 15% against enemies below half health.
